title: the Lord fights for you

verses.text: The LORD will fight for you; you need only to be still.”
For the LORD your God goes with you to fight for you against your enemies, to give you the victory.”

And he said, “Listen, all you people of Judah and Jerusalem! Listen, King Jehoshaphat! This is what the LORD says: ‘Do not be afraid or discouraged because of this vast army, for the battle does not belong to you, but to God.

caption:
Some battles are not yours to win. They are yours to stand still in.

Israel stood pinned between an army and the sea, and the word to them was not fight harder. It was be still. The battle belonged to God then, and the same God still goes ahead of his people now.

Exodus 14:14, Deuteronomy 20:4, 2 Chronicles 20:15 (BSB)
